title: A polynomial-time verifier for affine-isolated NP queries
claims: AffineIsolatedNPQueryVerifier constructs a polynomial-time verifier and an NP language of seed-conditioned queries for every pinned NP language.
The verifier checks the original bounded witness and the supplied affine seed in the pinned word-machine model.
For a yes-input, a good width has at least one eighth seeds accepting exactly one bounded witness; source no-inputs produce no accepting witness for any seed word.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against pinned definitions.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned reference checker where available. Otherwise compare source hashes with the submitted checker transcript, without awarding experimental Lean points.
